title: The Great Equipment Rebalance of 2021
subtitle: How Jagex cured 6 years of ranged stagnation and set up the next decade of PvM gear.
summary: In early 2021, Jagex unveiled the most ambitious combat rebalance project in OSRS history. The Toxic Blowpipe had suppressed design space for 6 full years—any new ranged weapon had to compete with a 2-tick machine gun. By slicing Blowpipe accuracy in half, nerfing Black D'hide magic defense, and buffing Crystal Armour and Mace weapons, the modern gear landscape was born.
keyTakeaways: Toxic Blowpipe base accuracy cut from +60 to +30
Black D'hide body magic defense slashed from +50 to +20, restoring Magic in PvP
Crystal Bow and Crystal Armour buffed by 15-30% damage/accuracy
Bow of Faerdhinen (BowFa) introduced as the bridge weapon between Blowpipe and Twisted Bow
Maces received +1 prayer bonus and 4-tick attack speed (matching Scimitars)

title: The Infamous Day-1 Broken Drop Tables Vault
subtitle: From the 100x Revenant Statuettes to 200 Noted Zulrah Magic Logs.
summary: Several major releases in OSRS history shipped with day-one drop tables so overwhelmingly lucrative that players made hundreds of millions of GP before emergency hotfixes were deployed. This exhibit chronicles the wildest drop table launch days in Gielinor.
keyTakeaways: Zulrah (2015): 100 Magic Logs, 100 Raw Sharks, and 20 Teleport scrolls per drop flooded skilling markets.
Revenant Caves (2017): Multiplier bug caused 100x ancient statuette drops simultaneously upon launch.
Konar Slayer (2019): Day-1 Brimstone Chest dropped 2,500 Saradomin Brews and 200 Torstol in a single roll before hotfix.
Nightmare of Ashihama (2020): Inquisitor pieces initially rolled without intended regional world protection.

title: The 6-Hour Sleeping NMZ & Splashing Saga
subtitle: The 2.5-year controversy where players reached 99 combat while asleep in bed.
summary: From 2013 to September 2015, OSRS had no automatic interaction timeout for combat. Players discovered two massive unintended interactions: wearing -68 magic gear to 'splash' on chickens for 6 hours uninterrupted, and using Guthan's healing armor in Nightmare Zone Rumble. When polling the fix failed repeatedly due to player self-interest, Jagex made their first historic unpolled 'Game Integrity' intervention.
keyTakeaways: Full Guthan's set healed more than NMZ bosses could damage, enabling 6 hours of hands-off training.
Splashing Fire Strike on rats in Lumbridge flooded banks with AFK mages.
Multiple polls to fix it failed to reach the required 75% threshold.
On September 3, 2015, Jagex established the precedent of Unpolled Integrity Updates with the 20-minute auto-retaliate timer.

title: The Metamorphosis of Great Kourend
subtitle: How a community Reddit map by GentleTractor rebuilt an entire fantasy continent.
summary: When Great Kourend debuted in January 2016, it was criticized for massive empty square roads, clone-stamped buildings, and artificial geometry. A passionate player named 'GentleTractor' drew a complete artistic redesign on Reddit. Jagex embraced the blueprint, hiring community artists and redesigning Hosidius, Shayzien, and the Catacombs into the most vibrant continent in the game.
keyTakeaways: 2016: Rigid grid layout replaced with natural organic hills and rivers.
2019: Hosidius rework creates the Woodcutting Guild and bustling farmer's market.
2021: Shayzien rework replaces barren dirt with an authentic military fortress.
2024: The tedious 100% favor system is permanently removed for seamless questing.

title: The Legend of the TzHaar Inferno
subtitle: The 69-wave gauntlet that pushed the human skill ceiling to its absolute limits.
summary: Released on June 1, 2017, The Inferno was designed to be near-impossible. Players had to manage 3 distinct combat style prayers while solving wave spawns, managing Nibblers, and executing the 1-shot shield walk against TzKal-Zuk. Woox conquered it 2 days later without a Twisted Bow in front of 60,000 live spectators.
keyTakeaways: First major PvM challenge that required true 1-tick prayer alternating and stack solving.
TzKal-Zuk's shield walk mechanic created the gold standard for high-stakes movement.
Remains the undisputed symbol of PvM prestige and game mastery in Old School RuneScape.
